vacancyList.postName: Gulm Samadeshak (Company Commander) [Promoted from Home Guard (Daily Duty Allowance beneficiary players included)]

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://bpssc.bihar.gov.in and click on the ‘Home Guard’ tab.
Click on the link related to Advertisement No. 11/2026.
Register using a valid and active mobile number and email ID registered in your name.
After successful registration, a Registration ID and Password will be sent via SMS/E-mail.
Login using the Registration ID and Password to fill Part-2 of the online application form.
Upload a recent colour photograph (white background, within 2 months, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif) and signature in English and Hindi (black or blue ink, white background, 15-25 KB, .jpg/.jpeg/.gif).
Pay the application fee online via Net Banking, Credit/Debit Card, or UPI.
Submit the application and take a printout of the acknowledgement for future reference.
Only one online application per candidate is allowed. Multiple applications will be rejected.

howToApply: Visit the official website: https://stetregistration.cbrt.co.in/
Complete Registration: Fill in details on the Registration Page, click ‘Generate OTP’, enter OTP to complete registration. User ID and Password will be sent via SMS to the registered mobile number.
Login using User ID and Password on the main page of the website.
Fill in the application form with personal, educational and other details.
Upload scanned colour photograph (size 80KB to 200KB, dimensions 3.5cm × 4.5cm) and signature (size 50KB to 200KB).
Pay the examination fee online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking/UPI through the selected Payment Gateway.

Upload self-attested copies of required documents (10th certificate & marksheet, 12th certificate & marksheet, Graduation certificate & marksheet, Post Graduation certificate & marksheet, B.Ed certificate & marksheet, other educational qualifications, residential certificate, caste certificate if applicable, disability certificate if applicable, ex-serviceman certificate if applicable).
Click ‘Preview’ to review the filled application form. Correct any errors and click ‘Save’.
After final submission, download and keep a hard copy of the application form.

title: CECE Board Recruitment 2026 – Assistant Manager, AAO, Accountant, Quality Controller, LDC Posts
shortInfo: CECE Board has announced notification for Assistant Manager, AAO, Accountant, Quality Controller, LDC posts. Required qualification: AICTE approved qualifications. Last date to apply: 24-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the official website: bceceboard.bihar.gov.in and click on the ‘Online Portal of BSFCSC Ltd.’ link.
Step 1 – Registration: Click ‘Click here for Registration’, fill in your details including email ID and mobile number, and complete registration to get a Registration Number and Password.
Step 2 – Basic Details: Login with Registration Number and Password, fill in Basic Details and click ‘Save & Next’.
Step 3 – Educational Qualification Details: Fill in required educational qualification entries and click ‘Save & Next’.
Step 4 – Experience Details: Fill in experience details and click ‘Save & Next’.
Step 5 – Upload Photo & Signature: Upload scanned photo and signature as per specifications.
Step 6 – Preview Application: Review all entered information. Click ‘Final Submit’ after verifying and checking the declaration box.
Step 7 – Payment of Examination/Counselling Fee: Pay the fee online via UPI or other available online payment modes (processing charges may apply). Fee once paid is non-refundable.
Step 8 – Download/Print Application Form/Transaction Receipt: Download and print the application form and transaction receipt for future reference.

title: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 – Faculty Posts
shortInfo: Nalanda University has announced notification for Faculty posts. Required qualification: M.Phil/Ph.D. Last date to apply: 15-09-26.
howToApply: Candidates are required to apply online only through the Online Link (Google Form) provided at the end of the advertisement. Log in to your Gmail account before clicking on the link.

Pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- for each position online directly to the University’s Bank Account (HDFC Bank, Account No. 50100079546912, IFSC: HDFC0002059). Note the UTR Number/Transaction Reference Number for the application form.
Submit a separate Application Form for each post applied for.

Forward the Form Response Receipt (Filled in Google Form) with CV and scanned copies of all relevant documents to recruitment@nalandauniv.edu.in (no hard copy accepted). Documents include: recent passport-sized photograph and signature; certificates and mark sheets of all examinations including research degrees; proof of teaching, research and professional experience; copies of published research papers and other academic contributions.
